claim_definitions.A: Sysmon EventID 10 TargetImage lsass.exe (D03 structured indicator)
claim_definitions.C: B plus documented WORKSTATION5 / Empire PowerShell agent PID association

definitions.complete_ledger: monotonic set union of arrived source-record claims
definitions.missing_event: fixed-reference evidence record not delivered; no inferred substitute
definitions.new_claim_event: event supports at least one claim not in complete ledger just before arrival
definitions.no_claim_event: event supplies none of the declared claims
definitions.repeat_claim_event: event supports one or more claims, none new to complete ledger
definitions.timely_ledger: monotonic set union of arrived claims whose synthetic delay is <= deadline

limitations: The three claims are nested by construction, not independent evidence of compromise.
C is scenario-documentation-assisted and is not a general SOC-detectable claim.
Novel claim acquisition is a ledger-definition consequence, not a validated usefulness score.
Repetition of a claim does not mean a record is operationally worthless or independent corroboration absent.
A monotonic claim set cannot handle contradiction, revocation, decay, provenance trust or negative evidence.
D03 event timestamps mix 679 source UtcTime and 5347 indexed-time fallbacks; cross-source ordering is limited.
No source-side/production transport latency is inferred; synthetic delay is relative to selected D03 timestamp.
This first D05 test deliberately excludes aggregation; D04 aggregation projections do not expose independent structured fields sufficient for a fair reclassification.

parameters.replay_order: synthetic arrival timestamp, source ID as tie-breaker

purpose: declared claim acquisition under raw event replay; not belief accuracy or SOC usefulness
